title: Industrial Design Intern
note: Consumer products studio; for current ID/product design undergrads, apply by Nov 12.

facts.summary: Summer 2027 ID internship on Fiskars consumer products, with mentoring from senior designers.
facts.duties: Research, sketching, rendering, mock-ups and prototypes, presentations, and a set summer design project.
facts.requirements: Current BID/BS student with a portfolio, basic Adobe CC and SolidWorks skills, and good sketching.
facts.apply: Apply through Fiskars Workday with a portfolio. The posting says the last day is 2026-11-12, and Workday's end date is 2026-11-13.
